payload.notes: one_owner_offenders only looks for the names a family lists, and no family lists a Wilson spelling; the D9a scans read role_fitness.py alone. A new def wilson or _wilson_interval in any other kernel module, or a copy like calibration_actuator.wilson (own formula, 90 percent, calibration_actuator.py:75-89), is red in no test. ARIA-LOW-950 tracks the one existing copy; once it is closed by hand, nothing detects the next one, and the retired name _wilson_interval is guarded only inside role_fitness.py. Close condition: Register the proportion interval as an ownership-atlas family (owner judge_calibration.py:wilson_interval, forbidden spellings including wilson and _wilson_interval; carry finding=ARIA-LOW-950 until calibration_actuator.wilson is folded), derive _RETIRED_DISCOVERY_SPELLINGS in aria-kernel/tests/invariants/test_atlas_one_owner.py from the family, and add a planted-forgery pin; the invariant is red on a second Wilson definition in a module other than judge_calibration.py, and OWNERSHIP-ATLAS.md is regenerated.
